description.value: Di Reggae Cafe is a Jamaican restaurant in Surrey serving traditional dishes like curry goat, jerk chicken, jerk pork, and flaky Jamaican beef patties using recipes passed down through generations. The kitchen emphasizes authentic preparation — meats are marinated for 24 hours in traditional spices and curries are slow-cooked with Caribbean seasonings. A welcoming community-focused spot on King George Boulevard, it offers both dine-in and online ordering for pickup or delivery.
